coverage_summary: One daily primary-source structural scan of infrastructure, energy, market design, logistics, productive capacity, credit access and institutions. Compared recent Oct 27 Brazil seized-assets, Oct 28 Korea HBM4, Oct 29 Australia energy, Oct 30 BOJ ETF staged hypotheses and earlier Pix-TIPS/Nigeria fibre. NBS Oct 31 manufacturing PMI size split (large 50.2, medium 48.4, small 47.5) is an operating-condition survey, not evidence of structural financing access or a durable opportunity; IEA Oct 14 global oil stock draw and World Bank Oct 28 commodity outlook are prior-vintage observations already within research. No new source-proven structural transition with perspective, accessible mechanism and falsifier established. No candidate fabricated; canonical Atlas untouched.
